item.title: SwissHouse XL by Davide Macullo Architects | HomeAdore
item.description: SwissHouse XL in Coldrerio, Switzerland, by Davide Macullo Architects, is a 2023 house shaped by rural memory, an octagonal plan, and a sharply cut roofline.

item.title: Hinge House by Workaday | HomeAdore
item.description: Hinge House in Colorado Springs, Colorado, United States, by Workaday, completed in 2024, is a view-driven house shaped by folded roofs, daylight, and outdoor connection.

item.title: Casa San Giacomo Opens Naples to the Living Room | HomeAdore
item.description: Casa San Giacomo in Naples, Italy, by Officine Architetti, designed in 2026, frames city views and daylight through an apartment renovation shaped by terrace living.

item.title: Casa Libertad: A Family House Shaped by Jungle Air and Sea Views | HomeAdore
item.description: Casa Libertad is a 2018 house by Salagnac Arquitectos in Guanacaste Province, Costa Rica, shaped by open-air living, louvered ventilation, masonry, wood, and stone details.

item.title: Sagamore North Cottage by Akb Architects | HomeAdore
item.description: Sagamore North Cottage in Muskoka District Municipality, ON, Canada, is a 2025 house by Akb Architects shaped by privacy, lake views, dark cladding, and overhangs.

item.title: Cabins Kravák: A Modular Retreat Planned for Efficient Living | HomeAdore
item.description: Cabins Kravák is a 2025 house project in Znojmo, Czechia, by Studio MA s.r.o., where modular cabins pair efficient planning with a close landscape connection.

item.title: Villa Litomyšl II: A Family House Shaped by Light, Slope, and Garden | HomeAdore
item.description: Villa Litomyšl II, a family house in Czechia by Studio MA s.r.o., was designed in 2021 around light, open garden views, and a L-shaped plan.

item.title: Casa Celeste by FADD Architects | HomeAdore
item.description: Casa Celeste is a 2024 apartment in Naples, Italy, by FADD Architects, where recovered brick vaults and custom details reorganize domestic life around hospitality today.

item.title: Casa Gana House in Thailand Balances Retreat Life with Gatherings | HomeAdore
item.description: Casa Gana in Pak Chong District, Thailand, by TOUCH Architect, completed in 2024, pairs a private courtyard arrival with west-facing views, terraces, and event use.

item.title: MMMM Apartment: A Milan Home Shaped by Heritage and Bold Contrast | HomeAdore
item.description: MMMM Apartment is a 2023 renovation in Milan, Italy, by Depaolidefranceschibaldan architects, where a metal service box reshapes an early 20th-century apartment with preserved rooms.
